breadth.us_breadth_population: priced public terminal universe, rotating and source-qualified

methodology.returns: decimal adjusted daily-close returns for Yahoo where supplied, price returns for Binance
methodology.rs: difference of returns across21 common daily dates, heterogeneous venue close clocks; descriptive comparison
methodology.volatility: 20 daily log-return sample SD annualized 252 stock/ETF/FX or365 crypto
methodology.trend: moving averages derived from available vendor daily closes; current session can be partial
methodology.cadence: 15-minute target, observed timestamps and rotating histories; GitHub cron best effort
methodology.intraday: 60-name core, closed15m bars; exact contiguous UTCwindows forh1/h4; no overnight/lunch/gap filling
methodology.market_gate: cash window plus bounded US and Hong Kong close catch-up after each official session and 90-minute publication allowance
methodology.data_scope: new public-source market facts and computed descriptive analytics
